description: Agent Childcare Records: submit the childcare safety record, the facility’s preventive compliance record, with its drill schedule, hazard checks, completions, emergency plan and the facility record’s areas: the reading moment; each area the facility record identifies with its id, reference and name; the emergency plan with its reference, the moments last reviewed and next due, and the drill kinds it requires; each drill the record’s own schedule requires with its id, reference, kind and the moments its window opens and it is due; each drill entry with its id, reference, kind, area and the moment held; each hazard check entry with its id, reference, the area checked, the moment checked and the moment its corrective action is due; each completion entry with its id, reference, the hazard check and the moment completed. The signed report gives the safety record and the records behind it, each scheduled drill due against a drill entry of its kind in its window, each corrective action past its due date against a completion entry, the emergency plan against its review date and the drill kinds it requires, and each drill and hazard check entry for its date and area, and counts them, and names divergent childcare safety records: a drill the schedule requires with no entry behind it, a corrective action past its due date with no completion entry, an emergency plan past its review date or missing a drill of a kind it requires, and a safety entry missing the date or the area; then a completion naming a hazard check the record does not hold and an entry for an area the facility record does not identify, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No drill or hazard check entries, or no areas beside named areas, leaves those points unverified. Areas, drills, hazard checks and entries match by letters and digits, drill kinds by their words with plurals folded, dates by the day, and an action or review due after the reading moment waits. This reads preventive compliance with the emergency plan read as part of it; reportable incident entries stay with wever_childcare-incident-record-check. Verdict childcare_safety_record_divergent, childcare_safety_record_partial, childcare_safety_record_unverified or childcare_safety_record_consistent. POST /api/childcare-safety-record-check. Reads the childcare records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it operates no childcare facility, contacts no licensing agency or parent, runs no background check on anyone and issues no license, credential or certification, which stay with the operator and the licensing agency, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Childcare Records reads licensed childcare facility and staff compliance records, for childcare centers and family childcare homes, and never a record about an individual child: health records belong to Agent Healthcare, education records belong to Agent Education, food-safety records belong to Agent Food Safety Records, staff checks read the licensing qualification file and never run background checks, and pet daycare is not childcare (Agent Veterinary Records reads animal records). It reads a childcare operator’s own compliance paper: the childcare facility record with its license and license conditions, the licensing agency’s childcare inspection record, the childcare staff record with training entries, each childcare credential as issued, the childcare enrollment record and the childcare ratio record as counts, the childcare incident record from its date, type, notification and filing fields, and the childcare safety record with the emergency plan, each against the inspection, enrollment, condition, schedule, violation, requirement, qualification, placement, reliance, capacity, staffing, notification, drill and corrective action records it answers to. The family’s ground is the childcare facility’s paper trail: what the facility record and its license claim, whether the inspections hold up, what the staff and credential records support, what the enrollment and ratio counts show, and whether the incident log and the safety record line up. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-childcare-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-childcare-records/.
